description: THE LOOP CASE. One harness that makes 40 real assertions from a SINGLE assertion callsite inside a loop. It must PASS. This is the control against the most tempting wrong version of the corroboration layer - demanding that the runtime count equal the static callsite count. That equality is not a property of correct code (a loop runs one callsite many times, an untaken branch runs it zero), so only the zero-versus-positive contradiction is enforced.
